metadata.notes:
No copyright or contents pages are present. Tight binding has meant some print falls into the gutter in this volume with occasional feint type due to light impressions and with some pages cut close to the text causing occasional cropping.
Pagination generally reflects the separate issues bound together in this volume with occasional irregularities.
